title: ADVENT NIGHT
LIGHT IN THE DARK
end: The Secret Place — prayers every day

scenes.a: Advent night finds you waiting in the dark.
Isaiah wrote, The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwell in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.
Lord, in these quiet weeks of Advent, we bring every lingering fear and heavy shadow into your presence.
As we wait for Christmas, let the promise of Christ's coming shine warmth into this silent room.
scenes.sub: LIGHT SHINING IN THE SILENT ROOM

scenes.a: Grant this weary heart restful sleep tonight, trusting that your morning light is already on its way.
scenes.sub: MORNING LIGHT IS ON ITS WAY
